'''Allosaurus''' are [[extinct]] theropod dinosaur [[creature]]s from the [[wikipedia:Jurassic|Jurassic]] era. A young allosaurus is called an ''allosaurus hatchling''. They are very large, intimidating and deadly dinosaurs with a vicious bite attack, and also have the ability to whip their tails. Their size is comparable to a [[great white shark]]. If captured and trained with a high pet value, and are also an [[exotic mount]]. Being reptiles, they are a source of eggs. They can be found in only [[savage]] versions of their standard biomes.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] like allosauri for their ''horns''.
